title: “The Other Side of Antisemitism” SCA Pesah message by Rabbi Joey Soffer

chapters.title: A different perspective on Vehi she'amdah
Antisemitism and staying united
chapters.about: Modern context and Hashem saving Am Yisrael

summary: Rabbi Soffer explores the meaning of "Vehi she'amdah" from the Haggadah on the holiday of Pesah. He discusses the idea that the pushback from others when we get too close to them serves as Hashem's way of protecting Am Yisrael from assimilation.
questions: What does "Vehi she'amdah" refer to in the Haggadah?
How does Hashem save Am Yisrael from destruction throughout the generations?
Why do the goyim push back against us when we get too close?
